conclusion_uk: У перевіреній scheduler-only зміні нової акустичної або RU pipe protocol регресії не виявлено. Actual AB доводить обмежене прискорення під заданим навантаженням, але не кінцеву latency/NVDA/фонетичну прийомку. Є неблокувальний robustness follow-up для помилки відновлення Windows priority API.
review_mode: Read-only independent review; no candidate/runtime/test edits, no model synthesis, no real process-priority changes, no helper build/playback/capture.

checks.generator_lifecycle: foreground_priority finally restores before PCM yield; StopIteration/exception/SynthesisCancelled flow leaves scope first. foreground_blocks finally closes source, including tuple/cache iterators; dispatcher close_stream also releases request cancellation state. 12 current tests independently rerun and passed.
checks.owned_handles: Only GetCurrentProcess pseudo-handle or int(self.process._handle) from the held Popen child is used; no PID scan/OpenProcess/reopen introduced. Native _russian_lock serializes warm/actual Russian stream accesses. Normal lifecycle retains Popen object and its handle until close; no PID-reuse selection introduced.
checks.priority_ceiling: Only BELOW_NORMAL0x4000 -> NORMAL0x20 is assigned. Existing NORMAL or other classes are unchanged; finally avoids overwriting an intervening external priority change. It does not introduce ABOVE_NORMAL/HIGH/REALTIME. This does not promise arbitrary pre-existing elevated classes are forcibly capped.
checks.RU_protocol: First JSON bytes, profile/text/optional seed, little-endian length/PCM decoding, next consumer backpressure, size0 completion, error sentinel and stop/zero-ACK semantics preserved. Promotion wraps the same send/read transaction and stop ACK; no extra next, buffering or PCM crop introduced. A malformed/incomplete packet closes the owned child conservatively.
checks.acoustic_inputs: Patch does not alter models, prompts, profile selection, text/seed/gain/tempo/controls or phoneme normalization. Dispatcher adds foreground wrapper around the same delivered_audio iterator; no reportLoading prerequisite remains. Actual UK/EN PCM hashes identical in all tested pairs.
checks.actual_restoration: AB trace has470 observed priority calls across2handles, no errors, both final BELOW_NORMAL. Dedicated cleanup repeat has82calls/2handles both restored, known native children polled reaped and stdio closed. Original transient active-job observation/forced cleanup remains preserved; repeat reached natural zero after20.5ms.
checks.actual_cancel_recovery: Raw actual dispatcher error -> recovery and RU firstchunk -> cancel/drop -> finished ACK -> subsequent UK PCM path verified in archived report; this is software pipe recovery, not physical audible cancellation.

follow_up_findings.severity: P2 robustness bound; not observed in actual Windows trace
follow_up_findings.finding: Restore SetPriorityClass return value is ignored. Injected fake kernel allowing promotion but returningFalse on restore leaves the fake live process atNORMAL without an exception/error receipt. This is an API failure branch, not a normal-path regression or actual handle-ownership escape.
follow_up_findings.action: A subsequent separately reviewed change should record restoration failure with GetLastError and current held-handle state; define bounded retry only while exact owned process is still live and NORMAL. Do not mask it by claiming guaranteed restoration. Frozen files were not edited.

open_bounds: Cold preload can hold _russian_lock while a BELOW_NORMAL child does blocking startup; actual first request may wait for that lock. This remains separate from the successful prewarmed AB result.

Native RU _size/_read/startup and stop-ACK remain blocking; cancellation cannot interrupt a native read already in progress. Current finally cleanup helps only when control returns. No P95/P99 or sub20ms cancellation claim.

Overlapping foreground scopes from different threads on one handle are not reference-counted. Current dispatcher is single consumer and RU work/preload is serialized; a future concurrent scheduling caller requires its own scoped/refcount design. Concurrent external close of RussianPipe is not made safe by this patch.
Non-stream reference/synthesize branches are outside the new foreground_blocks wrapper; speedup is established for the NVDA streaming worker path tested here.

Four observations per AB cell on one selected logicalCPU and requested60%duty synthetic competitor cannot establish general real-world throughput or tail latency. Requested duty is not a measured machine-wide utilization percentage.

RU produced8distinct waveform hashes across8AB utterances despite seed42. Same request/model inputs and preserved protocol do not prove native waveform identity or no spoken word loss; listening/phonetic alignment remains unverified.
No physical audio device, user NVDA, typing/Backspace, profiles/settings or user-level hotkeys tested in this independent review. Hardware clock helper was neither built nor executed.
